text: At 640x360 the checklist, help text, aim name/hint and 'Loaded your save' toast all overlap in the middle of the screen; the first checklist line runs past the right edge ('(2 of 4)' clipped against the clock). Hard to read. tick ~9592

Carrying a split log, the hint says 'Stack it on the woodpile by the hearth' but the woodpile is two low rails + logs in the dark back-left corner, left of the hearth and out of view when facing the hearth; it took several turns to find, and when aiming at it the carry message covers it at the bottom of the screen. A visible marker or 'to the left of the hearth' would help. tick ~13300

Lay-kindling hint says 'from the chopping block' but the kindling is a tiny pale stack on the far side of the block (around x-2.3,z6.5), hidden by the block when you stand where you split; at night it is only visible in lantern light. Took several moves to find. tick ~23550

Aiming at the full woodpile with empty hands, the hint line is blank ('Woodpile (4 logs)' only). The next step is 'Lay a split log on the andirons', so the player needs to take a log from here, but nothing says E takes one. Also the crosshair registers 'Floorboards' through the gaps between the four thin logs, so the pile is fiddly to target. tick ~26200

Took a split log from the full woodpile (4 of 4, ticked) to lay on the andirons, as the next checklist line asks. The first line un-ticks back to '[ ] ... (3 of 4)', so the step the player just finished reopens and they must go back out to split another round. The checklist says 4 but the real need is 5; either count the log on the andirons or say 'stack 4 and lay 1'. tick ~28000

Struck a match and held it on the laid fire: 'It catches.', flames visible and the room lit, state hearthLit=true, but the checklist line 'Strike a match and hold it till it catches' stays unticked (progress.burning=false) and the Kindle step does not complete, apparently because the woodpile line dropped to 3 of 4 when I took a log for the andirons. Nothing on screen tells the player why the visibly burning fire does not count. tick 29250

Correction to fire_lit_unticked: the 'Strike a match' line did tick at about tick 29900, ~35 game seconds after 'It catches.' (fire must grow to 0.6). So it is a delay with no feedback (no 'the fire is taking hold' meter), not a hard block. The Kindle step is still held open by the woodpile line at 3 of 4.

On Kindle completion the Welcome checklist plus 'ADA'S BRIEF' (9 lines) runs down to the middle of the screen and overprints the aim label ('Woodpile (4 logs)') and Ada's first line of dialogue ('Oh... it's warm.'), making both unreadable at 640x360. tick ~34200

Reveal (timelapse) title 'Ada's cabin, from ruin to ho...' runs off the right edge at 640x360; the last word is cut. Also the replay is very dark at this point (5:20 pm frame): the room is mostly black apart from the window. tick 34983 (tps 0 during reveal)

After the reveal (STEP: Done), the finished checklist + 'ADA'S BRIEF: ALL MET' list (9 lines) stays on screen permanently and covers the top two-thirds of the view; F1 only toggles the controls help, not this list. For the post-game 'walk around and admire the cabin' phase there is no way to clear the screen. Expected the checklist to fade or collapse once Done (or F1 to hide it). tick ~36400

The hearth fire lit at tick 28863 (one split log + kindling) burned out at tick 36063, only ~36 real/game seconds after the reveal ended (tick 34987): 'The fire has burned down to coals. Lay more wood and kindling.' Ada has just 'settled by the fire' and the cabin is now dark at 6 am; the warm ending scene lasts about 4 game minutes total. Expected the welcome fire to keep burning (or Ada to tend it) through the post-game; the HUD still asks for kindling 'from the chopping block' after Done.

Exterior at dawn (8:23 am, day 2) looks good: snowy ground, sunrise sky, lantern glow on the wagon cover; no floating or clipping seen on the cabin, lean-to, fence or mare. The finished checklist still covers the middle of every view. No chimney smoke now the fire is out.
